adjudication.rationale: In spec/models/topic_spec.rb, the example `it "is false if embeddable_host is blank"` now runs outside the nested `describe 'with an emeddable host'` setup. It no longer stubs `topic.has_topic_embed?` and does not set `SiteSetting.embed_truncate = true`, so `Topic#expandable_first_post?` returns false due to `embed_truncate?` being false by default, not because of any “blank host” condition. This is especially misleading because topic.rb removed the `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present?` guard (now `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?`), so the test name describes a condition the code no longer checks and the changed behavior (true when truncate enabled + embedded topic even with zero hosts) is not explicitly covered.
